verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs documents a first-party agent-testing feature for verifying responses, tool usage and multi-turn outcomes before deploying, which is a pre-production test path. Nothing shows a separate sandbox environment or that test runs are kept away from production data and live tool or API calls. The sandboxed JavaScript runtime only isolates tool code execution, not a test environment, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: a documented isolated sandbox or staging environment, explicit separation from production data, mocking or isolation of live tool calls during tests, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Agent testing lets you verify conversational responses, tool usage, and full multi-turn outcomes before you deploy.
Transform real conversations into test cases when you find an interaction where the agent underperformed.
